trigger: task intake produced a run context and operation request
steps: Load the declared input schema/contract and reject unknown contract IDs.
Validate required fields, closed-field policy, scalar/container types, ranges, and fixed enumerations.
Validate declared authority prerequisites and scope markers without reading or serializing credential values.
On any failure emit cascade.input.rejected, write cascade-pre-gate-result, and terminate before execution.
Only on complete pass emit cascade.input.validated and action.authorized with the same run/action/correlation identity.
invariants: The pre-action gate is complete before the deterministic action boundary is invoked.
Agent prose cannot coerce or reinterpret an invalid input into a pass.
A rejected input cannot produce action.result.observed or a success successor.
proofCeiling: Structural/type/authority-prerequisite validity only; no action or result proof.
